description: User approved page "Scalars without addresses" (https://claude.ai/artifact/6jYdi5cw1d27CZC85xkJih, From: Callables) on 2026-11-20, relayed by Callables. Owner: Callables. S1.0. First: a JIT test of a two-I64 return under apple_aarch64 and system_v, checking both words. Then stored_value as an ExternTy return (prim.rs return match; an R type for ir_interp register_banks), native and interpreter paths; the interpreter's as_ref_word boxing ends at these calls. Report any entry the 6-slot MAX_INTERP_EXTERN_ARGS limit refuses.

comments.text: Pair definition agreed with GC (C1, fz-9x7.11.2) on 2026-11-20: `#[repr(C)] pub struct Stored { pub word: u64, pub kind: u64 }` in runtime/src/any_value.rs. word = AnyValue::raw(); kind = ValueKind tag zero-extended to u64. Stored::of(AnyValue) and Stored::value(self) -> AnyValue, both #[inline(always)]; value() is #807's stored_value moved here, keeping the cold panic. C1's forward is (word: u64, kind: ValueKind) -> u64. Whichever of .44.1 and C1 builds first adds Stored and points #807's entries at it; the other rebases.

Name settled with GC as `Stored` (same word as the codegen lane). The definition is on the C1 row of GC's collector page, https://claude.ai/artifact/BB1FpQ1Cf7Jd5spZeLEWtg, which is authoritative for both .44.1 and fz-9x7.11.2.

title: A runtime entry answers a value that can be a number as its stored word and its kind
